sourceContext.details: Author assumes the so-called magnetic gaze for this application lesson and promises development exercises next; not an assessed prerequisite.

records.originalRussian: Всѣми средствами помѣшайте ему въ эту минуту отвернуться отъ васъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: Use firm direct eye contact for requests and prevent the other from turning away; at that moment is not a minute-long practice timer.
records.exclusionReason: Conflicts with voluntary attention/conversation and respect for disengagement. Documentary preservation only.

records.originalRussian: выдерживая его взоръ усиліемъ вашей воли.
records.normalizedEnglish: Look aside while watching indirectly, then sharply return gaze when the other looks back; source aims to catch a disadvantaged moment.
records.exclusionReason: Conflicts with voluntary attention/conversation and respect for disengagement. Documentary preservation only.

records.originalRussian: то очень хорошо будетъ имѣть что-нибудь подъ рукою, чтобы показать ему: образчикъ, рисунокъ или какой-нибудь предметъ, относящійся къ вашему дѣлу.
records.normalizedEnglish: Show a business-related sample, picture or object to draw attention and recapture gaze; not an ordinary-object observation exercise.
records.exclusionReason: Conflicts with voluntary attention/conversation and respect for disengagement. Documentary preservation only.

records.originalRussian: Не оставляйте его до тѣхъ поръ, пока не добьетесь того, за чѣмъ пришли.
records.normalizedEnglish: The author says not to permit the other to end the conversation and to remain until obtaining the objective.
records.exclusionReason: Conflicts with voluntary attention/conversation and respect for disengagement. Documentary preservation only.

records.originalRussian: Но если же все-таки ему удастся сдѣлать вамъ внезапное внушеніе или предложеніе, поймавъ вашъ взглядъ, то не отвѣчайте ему, пока не отведете своихъ глазъ на минуту въ сторону и не возстановите своего духовнаго равновѣсія.
records.normalizedEnglish: Maintain steadiness, look aside to consider a proposal, pause for a minute before answering an unexpected suggestion, then refuse firmly/clearly/politely if no; when in doubt say no.

duration.scope: Looking aside before answering an unexpected proposal, not total session duration.
duration.interpretationNote: Timing wording retained; no recurring stopwatch or progression schedule specified.

originalProcedureParaphrase: Avoid continuous gaze capture and look aside while considering a proposal.
Before answering an unexpected proposal, look aside for a minute and restore equilibrium.
For a refusal, look directly and say no firmly, clearly and politely.
When in doubt, say no; keep the metaphorical active partner alert and prevent the speaker from addressing the passive partner.
records.editorialNote: The protective thought-wave explanation is historical and unverified. Optional eye contact and ordinary decision-pause framing would be modern safeguards.

records.originalRussian: Вы должны научиться давать внушенія въ настойчивой, твердой, положительной формѣ;
records.normalizedEnglish: The author prescribes persistent firm positive suggestions, a voice expecting fulfillment and confidence in compliance.
Form a mental image of the meaning of confident persistence; a conceptual aid to the author's influence advice, with no specified stages.

records.originalRussian: Положительное сильнѣе отрицательнаго и поэтому всегда слѣдуетъ стараться избѣгать воспріятія положительныхъ внушеній, когда самъ находишься въ пассивномъ положеніи.
records.normalizedEnglish: The author says the positive is stronger than the negative and advises avoiding reception of positive suggestions when oneself is in a passive position.
records.editorialNote: Positive/negative here concern the author's dominant/receptive influence model, not a validated diagnosis or moral judgment of thoughts.

excludedAsTimers.reason: At that moment, not a one-minute exercise duration.
